# Guelph Furnace Repair

> Guelph Furnace Repair is a local HVAC company serving Guelph, Wellington County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 820-6222  |  Email: contact@guelphfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://guelphfurnacerepair.ca

Service areas: Guelph, Georgetown, Milton, Fergus, Elora, Acton, Rockwood
